meta.source: A Dictionary of Color Combinations (Seigensha), based on Sanzo Wada, Haishoku Soukan (1933-34). Read from page images of the scanned PDF.

hex_fields.display_hex: scan swatch color from the book's reference pages, white-balanced so the paper reads as white. Best for screens.
hex_fields.scan_hex: raw scanned color of the reference swatch (scan has a blue-gray paper cast).
hex_fields.hex_cmyk: naive CMYK->RGB of the printed CMYK values (oversaturated; kept for compatibility).

meta.method: Each swatch was sampled from the rendered page, the printed English label under it was OCR-read, and both had to agree with one of the 159 reference colors (CIEDE2000 vs that color's scanned reference swatch). Cross-checked with the book's back index (OCR) and an independent public dataset (mattdesl/dictionary-of-colour-combinations): 1032/1032 color-to-combination memberships agree.
meta.positions: 2/3-color: left to right. 4-color cross layout: top, left, right, bottom.
